`.env.example` is now trackable and everything else lines up. Build and lint are clean. I won't commit — just letting the changes sit as working tree edits unless you want them committed.

## Summary

**Storage choice: Vercel Blob** (`@vercel/blob`) — single env var (`BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`), works identically in local dev and on Vercel, returns a stable public URL to store directly on a note. No buckets/policies to hand-roll.

**New files:**
- `src/lib/storage.ts` — `uploadImage()`: validates mime type (png/jpeg/gif/webp only), rejects empty files and anything over 5MB, uploads to Blob under `notes/<userId>/<uuid>.<ext>`, returns the public URL.
- `src/lib/notes.ts` — in-memory `Note` store (mirrors the style of `src/lib/users.ts`), keyed by `userId`. `attachmentUrl` is the only trace of the file kept here — actual bytes live in Blob storage. `setNoteAttachment` is scoped to `(noteId, userId)` so one user can't overwrite another's attachment.
- `src/app/api/notes/route.ts` — `GET` lists the current user's notes; `POST` creates a note from multipart form data, optionally uploading an attached image.
- `src/app/api/notes/[id]/attachment/route.ts` — `POST` uploads/replaces the image on an existing note, ownership-checked via `getCurrentUser()` from `src/lib/users.ts`.
- `src/app/dashboard/NoteForm.tsx` / `AttachmentUploader.tsx` — client components for creating a note (with optional image) and attaching/replacing an image on an existing note.

**Modified:**
- `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` — renders the note list with thumbnails and the upload UI, wired to `getCurrentUser()`.
- `package.json` — added `@vercel/blob`.
- `.gitignore` — added `!.env.example` exception (the blanket `.env*` rule was swallowing it).
- `.env.example` — added `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` placeholder with setup note.

Verified with `next build` (all routes compile, including the two new API routes) and `eslint` (clean, no errors/warnings).

**Known limitation, consistent with existing code:** like `users.ts`, `notes.ts` is in-memory and auth is the existing single-user `getCurrentUser()` stub — notes won't survive a server restart and there's no real per-request session yet. That matches the current state of the rest of the app rather than being a gap I introduced.
